pages.title: False Vacuum Membrane
pages.text: A thin, shivering film that seems to hold two different kinds of emptiness apart. One side is our vacuum, the other a lower-energy one that would rather replace it. It is cold and faintly elastic, and I handle it the way one handles a soap bubble that could end the universe if it popped wrong.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)The Vacuum Drifters glide without quite touching our space. When I finally brought one down, its body collapsed and left only this skin behind - the domain wall it had been carrying around between its own vacuum and ours.
